headline.text: L1 S2 matrix piece found in product — *4 pallets* on hold pending X-ray re-screen, missing nut not recovered.

summary: One active hold at L1 S2 after metal matrix hardware entered product stream; X-ray caught it, similar piece tests positive. Target depositor at L1 S3 sent back for re-clean after pistachio allergen dust found post-sanitation. Reject sensor failure at L3 ML1 and incorrect lot code at L3 Matrix both caught and corrected on shift.

holds.title: 4 pallets pretzel pouches held for FM re-screen
holds.summary: Matrix 7 lost rubber screw head with metal plate and nut into product stream around 23:15; X-ray rejected bag with plate inside, nut still missing — 4 finished pallets from affected window pulled for re-inspection.
holds.status: On hold pending X-ray re-screening; test nut confirmed detectable by X-ray.

food_safety.title: Metal matrix hardware in pretzel pouch product
food_safety.summary: Rubber screw head with metal plate from Matrix 7 found in X-ray rejected bag at 23:15; accompanying nut missing and not recovered despite area search — maintenance removed all unused matrix knobs as precaution.
food_safety.status: Open — metal plate recovered in rejected bag, nut unaccounted for; 4 pallets on hold, test piece confirmed X-ray detectable.

food_safety.title: Reject sensor B100A failing on ML1
food_safety.summary: Sensor B100A not rejecting product, causing rail jams and large remelt volume at 08:54 — maintenance notified immediately.
food_safety.status: Resolved — no follow-up messages indicate sensor corrected or bypassed; no product hold mentioned.

quality.title: VFFS scale causing blow-offs and double bags
quality.summary: One side of scale not locked in, causing consistent reject blow-offs and product stuck between jaws; maintenance corrected but some issues persisting at shift end (03:47).
quality.status: Open — scale repositioned and improved but not fully stable; 1st shift to monitor.

quality.title: Flow wrap sealing failures on ML1 Cavanna
quality.summary: 26 of 1,050 pieces (3.4%) found with cut film causing package to open at 10:13; maintenance adjusted jaws, follow-up inspection at 14:09 showed 100% seal pass rate.
quality.status: Resolved — jaw adjustment corrected issue, confirmed by QA box inspection.

quality.title: Perforated belt tearing on S4
quality.summary: Blue perforated belt tearing in center during cleaning at 23:29; no FM found in product, no visible piece missing, belt marked for replacement before next run.
quality.status: Resolved — belt isolated, no product impact; replacement scheduled before startup.

quality.title: Truffle product too soft at cutter
quality.summary: First batch from truffle line exiting very soft, sticking in cut blade at 07:06 — temper confirmed in range.
quality.status: Open — blade cleaned and tensioned, first-batch startup issue.

sanitation.title: Target depositor failed re-inspection on S3
sanitation.summary: Target depositor marked complete on cleaning board but found with pistachio dust throughout equipment during startup inspection at 02:56; crew sent back to re-clean.
sanitation.status: Open — re-clean in progress, not yet re-inspected or ATP verified.

sanitation.title: ML4 mold ATP failures
sanitation.summary: 8 mold totes tested at 15:56, only 6 passed ATP on first attempt; second round at 22:01 showed 7 of 7 pass.
sanitation.status: Resolved — re-test passed, molds released for production.

allergen.title: Pistachio residue on Target depositor
allergen.summary: Same event as sanitation item — Target depositor found with pistachio dust after marked complete, creating allergen cross-contact risk for next product.

allergen.title: Incorrect lot code on Matrix pallet
allergen.summary: BEQ pallet ran with lot 26114 instead of correct lot 26211 at 02:42; scope unknown (may be single pallet or larger run).
allergen.status: Open — pallet flagged for investigation, extent of mislabeling unclear.

opportunities.text: Consider adding matrix hardware inspection to S2 pre-shift checklist — today's loose screw/plate on Matrix 7 mirrors similar hardware issues flagged earlier this week.
Review cleaning sign-off protocol on S3 — Target depositor was marked complete but failed visual inspection for allergen residue, suggesting crew rushed or checklist missed food-contact surfaces.
Add VFFS scale lock verification to startup SOP — today's blow-offs and double bags traced to unlocked scale side, a mechanical step that should be caught before product runs.
Add lot-code verification step to Matrix startup checklist — BEQ pallet ran with wrong lot code (26114 vs 26211), caught only during post-run audit.
